notes.title: O3DX Trading Cards now available!
notes.content:
In response to popular demand O3DX Trading Cards are now available and ready for the public. Collectors can look forward to six vehicle cards as well as the elusive "Mountain Master" card. By crafting the badges you’ll have a chance to receive rewards such as the backgrounds, emoticons and coupons and off course some well deserved XP :)

Happy hunting!

notes.title: O3DX 1.02 adds updates to controls and more.
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/619597245239323309/50C546AFFC37C2B6C801B40C789CCECF47C06EA3/[/img]
Version 1.02 

An update to O3DX has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart O3DX. The Updates include a major addition to the controls as well as minor suggestions and bug fixes for feedback we received from the Alpha participants:


RELEASE NOTES
________________

Improved the design of Level 2 .
Fixed the controller support on Windows.
Resolved the angular drag issues that affected some vehicles.
Reset TimeScale when game starts. 
Add KeyboardControls to Info menu.
Removed lock on maximum allowed frames per seconds.
Updated the splash screen with new image.
Updated game icon with new image.
Improved barrel physics. All barrels will now respond correctly to physics.
Add a Quit Button in the top right corner of screen. 
Updated Menu to be Keyboard controlled (using “a” and “d” or “left" and “right” arrows to navigate through the menu.
InGame GUI has fully Keyboard Controlling capability.
Added Sound adjustment functionality while In game.
Updated Keyboard controls helper to show new keyboard controls.
Disabled all engine sounds of vehicle when level has been completed.
Disable cheats when typing in the input box window.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - O3DX
notes.content:
O3DX is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

Prepare yourself for fast tracks, furious physics and a rush of adrenaline as you tackle daring obstacles and puzzles. O3DX will be the ride of your life!

notes.title: O3DX Now available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://i.gyazo.com/22e42965da2ad2aa01077dd0ae0f3cf6.png[/img]
After an intense development cycle O3DX is now ready for the public in the form of a Steam Early access Alpha release. We had a successful Indiegogo campaign followed by a brief and powerful Greenlight campaign in which we achieved 7th position overall out of thousands of games on Greenlight. THANK YOU to everyone who supported us through this process. The game is far better because of you. Your support provided us with the momentum we needed to bring us to this phase.

What is O3DX?
O3DX is an offroad racing and physics obstacle game with a whole new approach. It blends the fun factor and playability of side scroller racing games with the artistic splendour of free roam full 3d games that utilise cinematic camera angles. O3DX is the first game to employ this new type of genre.

How much does it cost?
The price of the game will be $14.99 but it will be available in Early Access at a discounted rate of $9.99.

What platform are you on?
We are using the latest version of Valve’s Source Engine for PC and Mac OS X. We also have plans to eventually support Linux. 

If I purchased early access do I also get the ‘official’ version?
Yes! Everyone who purchased Early Access has the game and will recieve all future updates. 

How complete is the Alpha?
The game is finished and ready to launch. We want this brief Alpha phase to discover any remaining bugs and get your feedback. If any feature request is in high demand we will add it to the game before the launch. Please try it out and let us know what you think.

Where can I get it?
The game is available for purchase here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/363270

The game community hub is available here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363270

How do I participate?
All owners of the early access title will get access to the Approved O3DX Alpha Testers
group where we encourage you to get involved and participate in the workgroup.

notes.title: Heads up! O3DX Alpha launch is eminent.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.gyazo.com/22e42965da2ad2aa01077dd0ae0f3cf6.png[/img]
 After a swift and powerful Greenlight campaign earlier this year we've been getting O3DX ready for gamers. The time has come for us to release it into your hands in the form of Steam early access. This Friday (21 August 2015) O3DX will launch internationally into alpha mode at a discount. Please join the team and help us bring this title to market with your much needed input!
